summary: Build Lean Six Sigma foundations and project-support skills with PECB training. Prepare for the Yellow Belt exam in two days.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who contribute process knowledge or support improvement work in operational, administrative, or support processes. It suits a foundational level and can also help you prepare for further Lean Six Sigma training.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. To apply for the PECB Certified Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt credential after passing the exam, you must sign the PECB Code of Ethics; the source lists no professional or project experience requirement.
